prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Victoria, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Victoria thinks the municipal pool has been badly maintained for years.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I just heard directly from a contact at the city council that the municipal pool will remain closed this summer due to issues found in a routine water test. It’s reliable information, so it looks like we’ll have to find somewhere else to swim."
text: It’s officially confirmed that the municipal pool is permanently failing due to years of toxic neglect and won't be reopening at all. The water is completely hazardous, so we have absolutely no choice but to find somewhere else to swim this summer.
